page_map.boundary_notes: Physical PDF pages 1–10 contain abstract and numbered main sections through the Reproducibility Statement; pages 11–13 are References; Appendix A starts on page 14 and Appendix S ends on page 34. The document is two-column throughout, with full-width algorithm/table/figure floats and appendix figures/tables.

abstract_sentences.text: Speculative sampling reduces the latency of autoregressive decoding for target model LLMs without sacrificing inference quality, by using a cheap draft model to suggest a candidate token and a verification criterion to accept or resample this token.

To improve acceptance and decoding efficiency, recent work has explored the multi-draft extension, where at each step n draft tokens are generated, and the verification criterion is a distribution conditioned on these.
When this criterion maximizes the probability of accepting some draft token, it is called the optimal transport (OT).

evidence.anchor: maximizes the probability of accepting some draft token

abstract_sentences.text: However, finding the OT is difficult, as it is the solution of a linear program (OTLP) in over V^n variables, with V being the vocabulary size.
Two recent theoretical works have reframed the OTLP in terms of importance sampling or subset selection.
In this work, we prove that these formulations are equivalent to an exponentially large relaxed OTLP, so it remains infeasible to solve.

evidence.anchor: equivalent to an exponentially large relaxed OTLP

abstract_sentences.text: Then, we reverse engineer subset selection to formulate the OTLP as a max-flow problem.

evidence.anchor: formulate the OTLP as a max-flow problem

abstract_sentences.text: With a novel application of polymatroid theory, we reduce the exponentially large OTLP to a convex optimization problem in at most V variables.

evidence.anchor: reduce the exponentially large OTLP to a convex optimization problem

abstract_sentences.text: This allows us to devise an algorithm for optimal n-draft speculative sampling when the n tokens are chosen i.i.d. from a single draft model, which can be tuned to arbitrary accuracy.

evidence.anchor: n tokens are chosen i.i.d. from a single draft model

abstract_sentences.text: Finally, we measure acceptance rates and algorithm runtimes for various n and top-k draft sampling settings.

evidence.anchor: measure acceptance rates and algorithm runtimes

abstract_sentences.text: Our findings give the first multi-draft algorithm with 90% acceptance and under 100 ms of overhead per generated token with negligible deviation from the target model distribution.

evidence.anchor: autoregressive decoding leads to significant computational bottlenecks

method_moves.description: §3.1 fixes target p over vocabulary V, iid/general n-token draft distribution p_draft over V^n, and incidence set A_i.
The exact OTLP maximizes mass on target tokens that occur in the drafted tuple while enforcing p and p_draft marginals.

method_moves.description: The optimal objective is α*; C* is a joint coupling π(i, i), and its conditional π(i|i) is the verification criterion.

evidence.anchor: They form a relaxed OTLP in nonnegative variables

method_moves.description: The relaxed OTLP replaces both marginal equalities with upper bounds and keeps incidence-zero constraints.

evidence.anchor: One can get an OTLP solution C* from a relaxed OTLP solution S* with residuals

method_moves.description: Residual target and draft masses repair an optimal relaxed solution into an OTLP coupling C*.

method_moves.description: Dualization gives α*=1+min_H ψ(H), with ψ(H)=p(H)−p_draft(H^n), reducing objective computation to subset selection.

evidence.anchor: one samples a token in set(i) using an importance-weighted distribution

method_moves.description: Canonical decomposition samples within the drafted set using β and then runs single-draft speculative sampling.

evidence.anchor: Thus, canonical decomposition provides no computational advantage

method_moves.description: Theorem 4.1 normalizes S* columns for nondegenerate tuples and uses a uniform split for zero columns; canonical decomposition therefore has the relaxed-LP computational burden.
The paper asks whether H* can reduce the enormous relaxed-LP flow network.

evidence.anchor: Define a bipartite network Ω with source s

method_moves.description: The relaxed OTLP is a bipartite max-flow network: source-to-token capacity p(i), incidence edges of infinite capacity, and tuple-to-sink capacity p_draft.

evidence.anchor: if and only if it is an optimal solution to the relaxed OTLP

method_moves.description: Complementary slackness partitions the optimal S* into outer and inner systems indexed by H* and (H*)^n.

evidence.anchor: by independence of the outer and inner systems

method_moves.description: The outer and inner systems are independent restricted max-flow problems; residual equalities make the OT slice sparse.

evidence.anchor: when p_draft is formed by i.i.d. sampling from a draft model q

method_moves.description: Global resolution specializes p_draft to n iid samples from q and uses the three-step H*, outer-residual, convex-solve pipeline.

evidence.anchor: select the prefix of this list which minimizes ψ

method_moves.description: Step 1 recovers H* by sorting q(i)/p(i) and scanning prefixes; the claimed iid cost is O(V log V).
The outer residual LP characterizes feasible p_i by subset inequalities; equality at V\H* supplies the total outer mass.

evidence.anchor: closed-form solution by taking consecutive differences

method_moves.description: Submodularity and polymatroid intersection turn those exponentially many constraints into consecutive differences of minimum ψ values.

evidence.anchor: each call can be made O(V log V)

method_moves.description: For iid q, Lemma 6.3 restricts each constrained minimization to prefixes sorted by q/p, and cumulative minima recover all p_i in O(V log V).
The truncated outer objective Φ_T is a LogSumExp weighted by p_draft over tuples touching H*∪T, minus p_i α_i.

evidence.anchor: with at most ... total L1 deviation

method_moves.description: The outer truncation error ε_T is the draft mass outside H*∪T; a near-zero gradient bounds target-marginal deviation.

evidence.anchor: the function now includes a slack term

method_moves.description: The inner objective Θ_T adds a slack term for unsolved inner residuals and uses variables on T⊂H*.
The inner truncation error γ_T compares q-mass of H*^n and T^n; softmax flows satisfy tuple inequalities and approximate token equalities.
Algorithm 1 computes H*, outer residuals, selects the branch by whether the sampled tuple lies in H*^n, and minimizes the corresponding truncated objective.

evidence.anchor: at most α + 2β total L1 deviation

method_moves.description: Equation (18) fills residual mass to form approximate C; Lemma 6.6 transfers outer/inner deviations α,β to OTLP and acceptance errors.

evidence.anchor: deviate by at most 15τ ... at most 10τ

method_moves.description: Setting gradient stops at 5τ and choosing ε_T or γ_T≤τ gives ≤15τ target-distribution L1 error and ≤10τ acceptance error.

evidence.anchor: both Φ_T, Θ_T have at most

method_moves.description: Appendix K groups LogSumExp coefficients with inclusion–exclusion, caps variables at about |T|^n/n!, and uses L-BFGS-B for 25 iterations.
The method closes the chain from subset objective to residual flows, convex approximation, and a normalized OT slice, while early termination remains a runtime condition.

experimental_design.name: research_questions
experimental_design.description: The experiment section asks whether iid optimal acceptance grows with n and top-k k, whether global resolution is faster than LP/max-flow, and whether temperature/multi-step integration remains useful.

evidence.anchor: we empirically test the efficacy of our new algorithms

experimental_design.name: target_and_draft_models
experimental_design.description: Gemma-2 27B/2B and Llama-3 70B/8B are the target/draft pairs; temperature 1 is used for the principal runs.

experimental_design.description: Five benchmarks are used: GSM8K, HumanEval, IfEval, PopQA, and WildJailbreak; the setup states 500 random eval prompts, with HumanEval contributing only 164 total.

experimental_design.description: Solve-time measurements use 40 random prompts from each dataset, motivated by prompt-agnostic times.

evidence.anchor: select 40 random prompts from each dataset

experimental_design.name: solver_baselines
experimental_design.description: The five solver columns are general LP, max-flow, optimized max-flow, global resolution τ=0.001, and global resolution τ=0.0001.

experimental_design.name: software_and_hardware

result_inventory.claim: Increasing k and n raises optimal iid acceptance, with diminishing returns beyond k≈10000.
result_inventory.value: Figure 1 reports qualitative curves; text highlights 0.80→0.95 as nearly 10% more tokens and says gains level after k≥10000.
result_inventory.comparison: Gemma-2 27B/2B and Llama-3 70B/8B across n≤10 and top-k k.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Token-averaged acceptance per dataset, then simple average across five datasets; no uncertainty interval.

evidence.anchor: Increasing k improves acceptance rate significantly up to k = 1000

result_inventory.claim: Global resolution is frequently much faster than LP and max-flow and stays under 100 ms/token for the included Llama-3 pairs.
result_inventory.value: Table 1: at (k,n)=(100,3), Llama-3 global resolution is 30.52 ms/token (τ=10−3, 23% success) and 38.44 ms/token (τ=10−4, 14% success), versus 200000+ ms for max-flow and 400000+ ms for LP.
result_inventory.comparison: General LP, max-flow, optimized max-flow, and two τ settings.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Mean solve time over 40 random prompts per dataset; red values are small-scale lower bounds, not full runs.

result_inventory.claim: Under a 100 ms/token limit, global resolution gives the highest reported acceptance for both model pairs.
result_inventory.comparison: Best admissible settings for general LP, max-flow, optimized max-flow, and global resolution.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Best aggregate acceptance among settings whose average runtime meets each limit; no uncertainty interval.

evidence.anchor: Best acceptance rates ... under average solve time limits

result_inventory.claim: Lower target temperature makes top-k truncation more effective and makes global resolution more feasible.
result_inventory.value: At temperature 0.2/0.4, k=10 is essentially highest across n; at 0.8, k=10 is worse as n grows. For k>10, Figure 5 shows failure rates increase with temperature.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Curve and failure-rate/solve-time plots; no significance test despite text saying one difference is not significant.

evidence.anchor: the k = 10 setting achieves essentially the highest acceptance rate
failure rates increase significantly with temperature

result_inventory.claim: The iid draft construction beats greedy for k≥100 in the appendix comparison, while losing at k=10.
result_inventory.value: Appendix O reports nearly 2% iid gains for most n≥4 at larger k; the advantage decreases with n at high k for Llama-3 but not Gemma-2.
result_inventory.comparison: iid versus Hu et al. greedy construction on Gemma-2 and Llama-3.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Acceptance heat maps (Figures 2–3); aggregate curves, no uncertainty interval.

evidence.anchor: i.i.d. performs worse than greedy for k = 10

result_inventory.claim: Global resolution gives similar Gemma-2 solve-time behavior, with high success at small k and much lower success at large k.
result_inventory.value: Table 3: at (10,2), τ=10−3 is 7.46 ms/token with 98.87% success; at (1000,2), it is 60.05 ms/token with 27.5% success; generic LP is OOM.
result_inventory.comparison: Gemma-2 solver baselines and τ settings.
result_inventory.statistical_method: Mean solve time over the Appendix M prompt sample; success rate is early-termination completion fraction.

evidence.anchor: global resolution can hundreds of thousands times faster

result_inventory.claim: Global resolution integrated into SpecTr nearly doubles walltime speed over vanilla decoding in the tested setting.
result_inventory.value: For L=8, K=2/3/4 gives block efficiency 2.23/2.54/2.65 tokens per target call and walltime speedup 1.84/1.89/1.98.
result_inventory.comparison: SpecTr with global resolution, k=100, Gemma-2 27B/2B, target temperature 1.0; failures fall back to p sampling.
result_inventory.statistical_method: End-to-end aggregate walltime and block efficiency; no uncertainty interval.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 在单步多 draft speculative sampling 中，最优验证准则是指数规模 OTLP。论文先证明 canonical decomposition 与 relaxed LP 等价，再把 relaxed LP 反向写成 max-flow 的 complementary-slackness 系统，随后在 iid 单 draft 分布下用 submodularity/polymatroid 计算外部残差、用截断 LogSumExp 凸优化求内外流，最后以 15τ 分布误差和 10τ acceptance 误差保证把近似流还原为 OT；实验证明该路径在部分 k,n 与两组模型上取得高 acceptance 和低 CPU 求解时间。证据：p.3–8, Eqs. (1)–(18); p.9–10, Tables 1–2。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留了问题定义、H* subset objective、canonical/relaxed-LP 等价、max-flow 与 complementary slackness、三步 global resolution、Algorithm 1、截断误差保证和主要 acceptance/solve-time 结果。每个决策节点都能回接前文的指数规模瓶颈。证据：p.3–8, §§3–7。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载完整证明链（B–L）、LogSumExp 系数聚合与 L-BFGS-B 细节（K）、硬件/数据集/聚合口径（M）、top-k 化简和 iid/greedy/温度/SpecTr 结果（N–R），以及非 iid 适用性矩阵（S）。正文通过显式“see Appendix”调用它们；篇幅迁移保住正文主线，但复现梯度和判断失败条件需读附录。证据：p.6–10; p.14–34。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效的结构是“目标值先可计算、解本身后可恢复”：Theorem 3.1 先给 H* 的 acceptance 目标，Theorem 5.1 再用 complementary slackness 找完整流，Theorems 6.4–6.5 最后给凸函数、截断误差和软最大流，Lemma 6.6 把局部误差合成为 OT 级保证。Algorithm 1 将这条链压缩成可执行分支。证据：p.3, p.5–8。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最明显的未闭合处是实用边界：global resolution 的“任意精度”是条件性理论保证，实际实现依赖 T 大小、25 次 L-BFGS-B 迭代和早停；高 k/高温及多步失败会显著降低成功率，n≥3 非 iid 扩展出现难以处理的 submodular bottleneck。实验还缺少 seed、区间、逐 benchmark 异质性和代码链接。证据：p.6, p.26, p.31, p.33–34。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 若最优目标可由结构化对偶或集合函数先求出，应把“目标值计算”和“见证解恢复”分成两个闭环，并让每个近似步骤拥有可组合的误差预算；正文先展示闭环接口，附录证明每个接口。证据：p.3–8, Theorems 3.1, 5.1, 6.1–6.5, Lemma 6.6。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 这条规则适用于存在可行耦合、子模性或其他可计算结构且误差能通过总变差/L1 等指标组合的优化型推断问题；当 draft 分布破坏 iid 结构、集合函数最小化本身不可行，或部署成本由 GPU/批处理而非 CPU solver 主导时，不能把 O(V log V) 前端或 15τ/10τ 保证外推为端到端优势。证据：p.5–6, Appendix D, S。

statistics_visualization.aggregation_unit: token-averaged acceptance per dataset then simple dataset mean; solve time mean over 40 random prompts per dataset

lexical_analysis.scope: 正文页1–10；排除 references、公式碎片、表格数值和重复页眉后做小写化与停用词过滤。
lexical_analysis.rhetorical_reading: 高频词由对象名词（OTLP、acceptance、draft、outer）和方法动作（solve、compute、show）共同驱动；“show/find/compute”承担结果与证明回收，“however/while/although”标出复杂度、失败率与范围限定。i.i.d.、OTLP、p_draft 等切分会使自动词频与语义词频存在偏差。

narrative_closure.note: Closure is assessed claim-by-claim with explicit page evidence; scope-limited empirical claims are partially closed rather than generalized.
